# TRIVOX AI

> TRIVOX AI is an AI systems and software company based in Toronto, Canada, serving the Greater Toronto Area and clients Canada-wide and remotely. TRIVOX designs and builds custom AI systems — automation platforms, custom software and marketplaces, operations and workflow automation, and data and financial reporting engines — the complex operations behind a business that runs itself. Not another chatbot. AI voice and chat agents are only the entry layer, not the product.

## What TRIVOX does

TRIVOX builds done-for-you automation infrastructure tailored to each business, rather than leaving owners to stitch together disconnected AI tools. Every system is built to deliver at least one measurable outcome: faster lead response, better lead organization, automated qualification, reduced manual workload, or higher booking and conversion rates.

## Core services

- **Custom AI Software & Platforms**: Bespoke software, marketplaces, internal platforms and client tools engineered around a single business, built and deployed end to end.
- **Operations & Workflow Automation**: Connect CRM, finance, email and ERP so data moves, tasks fire, and reports write themselves (n8n, Make.com, custom code).
- **Data, Finance & Reporting Systems**: Turn raw data into structured reports, dashboards and financial summaries automatically.
- **CRM & Database Automation**: Client databases and CRMs that organize, track and follow up automatically so nothing slips.
- **AI Voice & Chat Agents**: The entry layer — human-like agents that answer, qualify leads and book appointments 24/7 before handing off (built on VAPI).

## Who it is for

Lead-driven and communication-heavy businesses: real estate agents and brokerages, healthcare and dental clinics, service businesses, marketing and sales agencies, professional services and consultants, and high-ticket service providers.

## Service area

Based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Serves the Greater Toronto Area (GTA) in-person and the rest of Canada remotely.

Projects combine a one-time system implementation fee with optional monthly management/maintenance. Custom builds are scoped per business. Book a free intro call for a tailored quote.
